# Omni v1.5.4 - Table of Contents

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Omni](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.md): ![Omni](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aaronrussell/omni/main/media/poster.webp)
- [Omni.Codec](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Codec.md): Lossless serialisation of Omni structs to and from JSON-safe maps.
- [Omni.Model](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Model.md): A data struct describing a specific LLM.
- [Omni.Schema](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Schema.md): Builders and validation for JSON Schema maps.
- [Omni.Schema.Adapter](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Schema.Adapter.md): Behaviour for plugging in alternative schema validators.
- [Omni.StreamingResponse](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.StreamingResponse.md): A streaming LLM response that yields events as they arrive from the provider.
- [Omni.Tool](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Tool.md): Reusable, validated tools that an LLM can invoke during a conversation.
- [Omni.Tool.Runner](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Tool.Runner.md): Executes tool use blocks in parallel and returns tool result blocks.

- Data
  - [Omni.Content.Attachment](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Content.Attachment.md): An attachment content block for binary content such as images, PDFs, and
other media.
  - [Omni.Content.Text](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Content.Text.md): A text content block.
  - [Omni.Content.Thinking](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Content.Thinking.md): A thinking content block representing the model's chain-of-thought reasoning.
  - [Omni.Content.ToolResult](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Content.ToolResult.md): A tool result content block representing the output of a tool invocation.
  - [Omni.Content.ToolUse](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Content.ToolUse.md): A tool use content block representing the model's intent to invoke a tool.
  - [Omni.Context](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Context.md): The context for a conversation with an LLM.
  - [Omni.Message](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Message.md): A message in a conversation.
  - [Omni.Response](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Response.md): The result of a text generation request.
  - [Omni.Usage](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Usage.md): Token counts and computed costs for a generation request.

- Providers
  - [Omni.Provider](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Provider.md): Behaviour and shared logic for LLM providers.
  - [Omni.Providers.Alibaba](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Providers.Alibaba.md): Provider for the Alibaba Cloud (DashScope) API, using the
`Omni.Dialects.OpenAICompletions` dialect.
  - [Omni.Providers.Anthropic](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Providers.Anthropic.md): Provider for the Anthropic API, using the `Omni.Dialects.AnthropicMessages`
dialect.
  - [Omni.Providers.Google](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Providers.Google.md): Provider for the Google Gemini API, using the `Omni.Dialects.GoogleGemini`
dialect.
  - [Omni.Providers.Groq](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Providers.Groq.md): Provider for the Groq API, using the `Omni.Dialects.OpenAICompletions`
dialect.
  - [Omni.Providers.Moonshot](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Providers.Moonshot.md): Provider for the Moonshot AI (Kimi) API, using the
`Omni.Dialects.OpenAICompletions` dialect.
  - [Omni.Providers.NearAI](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Providers.NearAI.md): Provider for NEAR AI Cloud, including TEE-backed inference models, using the
`Omni.Dialects.OpenAICompletions` dialect.
  - [Omni.Providers.Ollama](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Providers.Ollama.md): Provider for the Ollama API, using the `Omni.Dialects.OllamaChat` dialect.
  - [Omni.Providers.OpenAI](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Providers.OpenAI.md): Provider for the OpenAI API, using the `Omni.Dialects.OpenAIResponses`
dialect.
  - [Omni.Providers.OpenCode](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Providers.OpenCode.md): Provider for the OpenCode Zen API.
  - [Omni.Providers.OpenRouter](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Providers.OpenRouter.md): Provider for the OpenRouter API, using the `Omni.Dialects.OpenAICompletions`
dialect.
  - [Omni.Providers.Venice](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Providers.Venice.md): Provider for the Venice AI API, using the `Omni.Dialects.OpenAICompletions`
dialect.
  - [Omni.Providers.Zai](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Providers.Zai.md): Provider for the Z.ai API, using the `Omni.Dialects.OpenAICompletions`
dialect.

- Dialects
  - [Omni.Dialect](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Dialect.md): Behaviour for wire format translation between Omni types and provider APIs.
  - [Omni.Dialects.AnthropicMessages](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Dialects.AnthropicMessages.md): Dialect implementation for the Anthropic Messages wire format.
  - [Omni.Dialects.GoogleGemini](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Dialects.GoogleGemini.md): Dialect implementation for the Google Gemini wire format.
  - [Omni.Dialects.OllamaChat](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Dialects.OllamaChat.md): Dialect implementation for the Ollama native chat API wire format.
  - [Omni.Dialects.OpenAICompletions](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Dialects.OpenAICompletions.md): Dialect implementation for the OpenAI Chat Completions wire format.
  - [Omni.Dialects.OpenAIResponses](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Omni.Dialects.OpenAIResponses.md): Dialect implementation for the OpenAI Responses wire format.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix models.get](https://omni.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Models.Get.md): Fetches model catalog data from models.dev and writes JSON files to `priv/models/`.
